title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.1.8.421
body_markdown:
### Fixed

* Pressing TAB was over-eager to insert Copilot's suggestions to the editor.
* Turn off GitHub Copilot if [light edit mode](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/idea/lightedit-mode.html) is enabled.
body_html:
Fixed

  • Turn off GitHub Copilot if light edit mode is enabled.
